title: RV Recall Updates | September 8, 2026
summary: Get the latest on RV recalls for September 8, 2026, including safety updates and next steps for affected owners.
body_markdown:
Here’s a quick recap of this week’s NHTSA RV Recall updates, along with some next steps for RV owners.


## Jayco Recalls


The wiring for the auto-level jack travel lockout on certain 2027 Eagle, Eagle SLE, and Heartland Sundance fifth wheels was not installed during production. As a result, a user could activate the leveling jacks via the phone app while the vehicle is in motion, increasing the risk of a crash.


Dealers will install a jumper wire, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed on September 11, 2026. VINs involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning September 11, 2026.


> *Learn more under recall*[#9901665](https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2026/RCLRPT-26V518-5347.pdf) *.*


---


The certification label on certain 2027 Heartland Bighorn fifth wheels may list an incorrect axle rating — 8,000 pounds when the axles are actually rated at 7,000 pounds. This discrepancy could lead an owner to overload the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.


Jayco will mail replacement labels to owners, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed on September 30, 2026. VINs involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning September 30, 2026.


> *Learn more under recall*[#9901666](https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2026/RCLRPT-26V552-4130.pdf) *.*


---


The certification label on certain 2026-2027 Seneca, Seneca Prestige, Entegra Accolade, and Entegra Accolade XL motorhomes lists an incorrect tire size — 275/80R22.5 instead of the correct 295/80R22.5. Incorrect tire information on the label could result in the wrong tires being installed on the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.


> *Learn more under recall*[#9903664](https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2026/RCLRPT-26V554-1262.pdf) *.*


---


The taillight harness on certain 2027 Melbourne Prestige and Entegra Qwest motorhomes contains an incorrect 10-ohm resistor instead of the required 100-ohm resistor. This may trigger a false taillight warning on the dashboard when the taillights are functioning properly, potentially confusing drivers and increasing the risk of a collision.


Dealers will replace the taillight harness, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed on September 30, 2026. VINs involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning September 30, 2026.


> *Learn more under recall*[#9903667](https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2026/RCLRPT-26V555-9890.pdf) *.*


## Forest River Recalls


The furnace may not be properly installed against the sidewall on certain 2027 Forest River Vibe travel trailers, leaving the exhaust and intake tubes without adequate overlap on the outside flue. If the flue is not properly sealed, carbon monoxide may leak back into the trailer, increasing the risk of injury or death to occupants.


Dealers were notified on September 1st, 2026, and will inspect and, if necessary, reposition the furnace, free of charge.


> *Learn more under recall*[#26V563](https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2026/RCLRPT-26V563-6702.pdf) *.*


## Tiffin Motorhomes Recalls


The LP tank on certain 2026-2027 Tiffin Wayfarer motorhomes was installed more than 18 inches from the outside wall without a remote shut-off valve, and the front mounting bracket was not built to specification. If the shut-off valve cannot be accessed in an emergency, there is an increased risk of fire. If the tank becomes loose due to the incorrect bracket, it could increase the risk of an accident.


Dealers will install a remote shut-off and replace the bracket, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed on October 30, 2026. VINs involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 30, 2026.


> *Learn more under recall*[#WAY-108](https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2026/RCLRPT-26V557-5801.pdf) *.*


## Are You Affected?


Use your vehicle’s VIN to check if you’re affected by these recalls.


- [Forest River Recall Search](https://forestriverinc.com/recall-search)
- [Jayco Recall Search via the NHTSA Tool](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/recalls#vin)
- [Tiffin Recall Search](https://tiffinmotorhomes.com/recall-lookup/)


## What To Do Next


If your search indicates that your vehicle may be affected by these recalls, your next step is to schedule an inspection with a certified RV technician to evaluate your vehicle and determine whether repairs are recommended.


[Schedule an Inspection](https://cwrv.link/brvservice)
